method: Published family references plus explicit editorial complexity rubric applied to existing per-ID source and title evidence. Proposals are inferences, not 1,257 independently verified external exercise prescriptions. Existing sourced fields take precedence; only empty fields are completed.
difficultyMeaning: Technical complexity under controlled baseline execution, not personalized safety, load, training intensity or a clinical recommendation.

conventions.compound: Several joints participate in the dynamic task.
conventions.isolation: A principal joint action dominates the task.
conventions.isometric: The main task is to maintain a position.
conventions.mixed: The complete task combines directions or cyclic phases; it is not being forced into push/pull.
conventions.notApplicable: A strength-mechanics/action label does not apply, e.g. self-massage.

nsca-complexity.scope: Framework for technical complexity and progression; not per-variant difficulty ratings.

hprc-actions.scope: Definitions of push, pull and exercise categories; mixed/static are explicit catalog extensions.

ace-curl.scope: Supported machine biceps curl reference; variants are editorial inferences.

ace-plank.scope: Front plank reference; other core variants are not individually certified.

ace-press.scope: Supported seated machine chest press reference.

ace-clean-press.scope: Kettlebell clean-and-press reference: advanced, integrated movement.

ace-leg-extension.scope: Knee extension and effects of support, resistance and unstable surfaces.

nasm-leg-curl.scope: Seated knee-flexion reference; does not resolve dataset animation conflicts.

nasm-progression.scope: Stability, coordination and unilateral progression principles.

nasm-isometric.scope: Isometric core activity; not a rating for every static hold.

ace-stretch-types.scope: Distinction between sustained static stretching and continuous dynamic mobility.

fig-elements.scope: Gymnastics distinguishes static strength supports/planches from dynamic strength and balance elements.
